bio_md:
# 汉少帝辩 · 主要事迹

刘辩是[[e-han-ling|灵帝]]之子，何皇后所生。中平六年灵帝崩，辩即位，何太后临朝，大将军何进秉政。东汉的最后一场宫廷剧，就在这几个月内演完。

何进欲诛宦官，却迟疑不决，反召四方兵将入京示威——包括并州牧董卓。事泄，宦官张让等先发制人，杀何进；袁绍等率兵入宫，尽诛宦官二千余人，「十常侍乱」的结局，是宦官与外戚同归于尽。随后入京的董卓成了唯一的赢家：九月，董卓废少帝辩为弘农王，立陈留王刘协，即[[e-han-xian|献帝]]。

辩在位不足半年，被废后幽于阁上。初平元年正月，董卓遣郎中令李儒进鸩，辩临终与妻唐姬作诀别歌，时年十四。他一生没有做过任何决策，却亲身见证了东汉皇权最后的崩塌：在他之前，皇帝尚是外戚与宦官争夺的猎物；在他之后，皇帝成了军阀手里的印玺。

> 参考：点校本《后汉书》卷008《孝灵帝纪》、卷009《孝献帝纪》、《董卓传》、《何进传》，谭图第 2 册。

bio_parts_en.value: Liu Bian was the son of

by Empress He. When Ling died in the sixth Zhongping year, Bian took the throne with Empress Dowager He in the regency and General-in-Chief He Jin in power. The last court drama of Eastern Han was played out in these few months.

He Jin meant to destroy the eunuchs, but hesitated and instead summoned troops from the provinces to overawe the court — including Dong Zhuo, governor of Bingzhou. The plot leaked; the eunuchs led by Zhang Rang struck first and slew He Jin; Yuan Shao and others stormed the palace and slaughtered more than two thousand eunuchs. The "chaos of the Ten Attendants" ended with eunuchs and consorts destroying each other. Dong Zhuo, arriving on cue, was the sole victor: in the ninth month he deposed Bian as Prince of Hongnong and raised the prince of Chenliu, Xie, as

.

Bian had reigned under half a year. Deposed, he was shut up in a tower; in the first month of the first Chuping year Dong Zhuo sent Li Ru with poisoned wine. Bian sang a farewell to his wife Tang Ji as he drank, and died at fourteen. He never made a single decision of his own, yet he witnessed the final collapse of Han sovereignty: before him the emperor had been the prize fought over by consorts and eunuchs; after him, the emperor became a seal in the hands of warlords.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Hou Hanshu*, ch. 8 (Benji of Emperor Ling), ch. 9 (Benji of Emperor Xian), and the biographies of Dong Zhuo and He Jin; Tan Qixiang's atlas, vol. 2.
